purpose: Cover AC-15701-2 (submit calls gh search + create/comment per the zero/one/many hit table) and AC-15701-3 (search unavailable falls through to create with dedupe: unchecked; closed-state hit stamps a previously reported reference into the create body). Slice 4 arm of US-15701.
title: Slice 4 (FBS-183): dedupe search folds zero/one/many hits into create or +1 comment; search unavailable falls through with dedupe: unchecked and closed hits stamp a previously reported reference

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-2 (zero-hit arm) via the CLI test: with the configurable gh fake returning { matches: [] }, submit --yes calls ghIssueCreate for each entry and stamps dedupe: new.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15901-1: submit --yes with zero-hit search creates each entry, marks submitted, prints URL

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-2 (one-hit verified arm, 0.28.2 #234) via the CLI test: with the fake returning one search match whose body carries the same fingerprint line, submit calls ghIssueGetBody to verify, then ghIssueComment on that number with the full report; no ghIssueCreate.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-2: a verified fingerprint match folds via comment; comment body carries the full report; stdout names the matched title

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-2 (many verified matches arm, 0.28.2 #234) via the CLI test: with three matches whose bodies all carry the entry's fingerprint line, submit comments on the lowest number and the comment body carries the full report + mentions of the other numbers.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-2: many verified fingerprint matches fold on the lowest number and mention the others

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-3 (search failure arm) via the CLI test: with search returning { error: 'search-unavailable' }, submit falls through to create and stamps dedupe: unchecked on the entry state.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-3: search error falls through to create with dedupe:unchecked

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-3 (closed-hit arm) via the CLI test: with open search empty and closed search returning #88, submit creates a new issue whose body carries 'Previously reported and closed as #88'.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-3: closed-state hit produces a create with previously reported reference

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-2 (fingerprint-verification arm, 0.28.2 #234) via the CLI test: a search hit whose body carries a DIFFERENT fingerprint line is a non-match; submit falls through to create rather than comment.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-2: a search hit whose body carries a DIFFERENT fingerprint is a non-match; submit creates rather than comments

testCases.description: Cover AC-15701-2 (refuse fold across differing anchor/target arm, 0.28.2 #234) via the CLI test: a fingerprint match against a candidate whose anchor disagrees is refused; submit creates rather than comments.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-submit.test.js::AC-15701-2: a fingerprint match against a candidate whose anchor disagrees is refused; submit creates rather than comments
